name: Camp Woodstock
description_short: A YMCA overnight camp in a pine forest on Black Pond in Woodstock Valley for boys and girls 8 to 16, in one or two week sessions, with a leader in training program for 15 and 16 year olds. Campers choose their own activities, from archery, climbing and canoeing to theater and music, and the whole camp plays an evening game each night. A day camp for ages 6 to 12 runs at the same site.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Home page: sleepaway camp for boys and girls ages 8 to 16 on Black Pond; address 42 Camp Road, Woodstock Valley, CT 06282.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2027 overnight dates and rates. Prices are Tier 1 (the true cost): $2,395 for a 2 week session (ages 8 to 15), $1,475 for a 1 week session (ages 8 to 14); Tier 2 and Tier 3 are $100 and $200 less. Also 2027 Leader in Training (ages 15 to 16, 4 weeks, $3,665 Tier 1), Tenderfeet for first time 8 and 9 year olds ($795 Tier 1), and Day Camp for ages 6 to 12 ($315 a week, June 28 to August 20). Financial assistance for households under $100,000. Sunday drop off 1 to 3 pm, Friday pick up 5:30 to 7 pm. Page footer names the YMCA of Greater Hartford.
Researched by Claude from this page. Activity list and evening programs; Unit 1 (ages 8 to 10) chooses from a shorter list.
Researched by Claude from this page. FAQ: all meals in the dining hall, with a salad bar at lunch and dinner. Cabins of 8 to 12 campers of the same gender with 3 staff.
